title: Memories of Murder
why: Bong is 2 for 2 with you. A procedural that moves, and it ends unresolved but meaningful — which is the version of ambiguity you actually like.

title: Dead Ringers
why: Identical twin gynaecologists who share a life until neither can tell which one he is. The most literal version of the pattern that runs through everything you rate 4½ and up — and it fills the single largest lineage gap you have.

title: The Handmaiden
why: Twist architecture in the Prestige tradition: reveals that re-explain everything before them.

title: Dog Day Afternoon
why: The film Good Time is made out of. One bad day, one location, escalating in real time. If any old film disproves the pacing worry, it's this one.

title: Prisoners
why: A moral vice tightening for two and a half hours. The closest thing to a No Country you haven't seen.

title: Se7en
why: Zodiac and Gone Girl are both logged. This one has an ending that lands, which is the thing Beau didn't do.

title: Sick of Myself
why: You gave The Drama a 4 and haven't watched either of his others. Cheapest available win — same director, same cruel comedy, already proven.

title: Heat
why: Nolan's stated model for The Dark Knight, and you have no Mann at all. Long, but it's a heist film, not a meditation.

title: Don't Look Now
why: Sits at the junction of two of your lines: Roeg's fractured cutting is where Memento comes from, and the grief-horror is where Hereditary comes from.

title: There Will Be Blood
why: Same director as The Master, same slow-collapsing lead performance, more narrative spine holding it together.

title: Save the Green Planet!
why: The original that Bugonia remakes. You rated the remake 4½ sight-unseen on the source.

title: Anomalisa
why: Completes Kaufman. Everyone in the world has the same face and voice — doubling taken to its endpoint, and only 90 minutes.

title: The Wailing
why: Korean folk horror, genuinely frightening, genuinely about faith. Between Apostle and The Witch.

title: Caché
why: Restored to the list. 117 min, cold, buried guilt. Closer to Gone Girl than to Ran.

title: The Vanishing
why: Restored. 107 min, tightly wound, one of the most upsetting endings in cinema.

title: Inside Llewyn Davis
why: The most A Serious Man-adjacent Coen — a man in a loop, punished by an indifferent universe.

title: Decision to Leave
why: Quieter Park. A puzzle with real feeling underneath.

title: mother!
why: Either lands hard or annoys you. Given Beau, possibly the latter.

title: Hour of the Wolf
why: Bergman doing outright horror in 90 min. If the two 5-stars weren't a fluke, this is where it shows.
